_comment: Always-on critical safety baseline (plan.md Phase 2). Merged into EVERY customer config and not disableable in pilots, so a narrow user policy (e.g. violence-only) can never hide a universal critical threat. Every rule here is still verified by TrueSight (the VLM gate) before it reaches the operator. Every safety detector the engine can emit MUST have a rule here: a detector whose event nothing listens for is silently discarded, which is how crowd and panic-running went unnoticed. A detector only contributes if the camera enables it.
